name: Unauthenticated Telnet on airframe network
summary: Flags a successful Telnet negotiation reaching a BusyBox/root banner on the drone AP subnet.
rule: alert tcp any any -> $HOME_NET 23 (msg:"UAS unauthenticated Telnet root banner"; flow:established,to_client; content:"BusyBox"; nocase; content:"built-in shell"; distance:0; classtype:attempted-admin; sid:9000001; rev:1;)

name: Exposed RTSP video stream on airframe
summary: Flags unauthenticated RTSP DESCRIBE on the drone subnet (open video feed enumeration).
rule: alert tcp any any -> $HOME_NET 554 (msg:"UAS open RTSP DESCRIBE (no auth)"; flow:established,to_server; content:"DESCRIBE rtsp://"; nocase; content:!"Authorization:"; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:9000002; rev:1;)

name: Remote ID broadcast flood / spoofing
summary: Zeek script sketch: alert when Open Drone ID basic-ID messages exceed a per-second threshold from one source, indicating spoof flooding.

name: Vulnerable firmware fingerprint
summary: Identifies a firmware image containing the affected vtwo_sdk service string for triage (replace placeholder strings with confirmed artefacts).
rule:
rule uas_vtwo_sdk_present {
  meta:
    description = "Flags firmware containing vtwo_sdk service (triage only)"
    reference = "CVE-2023-51454"
  strings:
    $s1 = "vtwo_sdk" ascii
    $s2 = "DUML" ascii
  condition:
    all of them
}
